summary: Introduction recall is only partially observable: 2/2 available, source-reviewed introduction replays BLOCK the paired family (100% conditional sensitivity), but both are Vite families introduced by the same commit, not independent successful events. Across all eight dev families, two introduction pins remain unverified and four verified births are UNAVAILABLE even after a warm-index retry (timeouts, including a git subprocess timeout); none is counted as a false negative. Thus 2/8 is only an observed detected lower bound, not an end-to-end recall estimate for all eight or for production. The prior selected-pair dev OOF sensitivity is 4/28 and is not this recall calculation. Test-only assertions and magic tag methods are outside normal candidate coverage, but their unavailable end-to-end runs are not silently relabeled negative. Cold and retry attempts are retained. Definition-line blame only establishes a candidate: both sites, parsed parent absence and initial common logic were checked. It does not prove that no semantically similar ancestor existed under an earlier name.
